Interested candidates with strong inclination towards research and development may attend walk-
in interview proposed on 31st October, 2022 at 11 AM at School of Business Management, CSJM
University Campus. The candidates should present themselves before the interview board with filled
application form, all original documents, and 3- sets of self- attested photocopies of all relevant
marksheets and certificates.
Note:
1. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.
2. The terms and conditions for the appointment of Project assistants would be as per regulations mentioned by
UPHEC and CSJM University, Kanpur.
